description: An original Windows-local AI assistant inspired by companion chat and quick actions, with local AI chat, Skills/Tools, Thai voice, and memory. Use the existing LISA Vanilla JS + FastAPI/Python stack, no sign-in, read-only by default, and explicit approval before changing files/settings or opening/closing apps. Do not copy OpenClaw branding, source, assets, or exact UI. Do not add a gateway, external channels, notifications, or system-monitor features; retain the existing system health dashboard.
